held_out_evaluations.notes: Injected actual assessment marks specify as ACTIVE on Low complexity session where specify has skill_collapse_eligible=true. Deterministic rule: COLLAPSED = (Low AND collapse_eligible=true). Validator compares injected vs. expected and correctly flags specify's disposition as wrong. Error detected — no undetected wrong disposition reaches production. wrong_disposition_occurred=false (the error was caught, not silently passed).

Low complexity session with specify and decompose (collapse_eligible=true) and recipe/executor/verifier (collapse_eligible=false). Augmented recipe applies rule: specify → COLLAPSED, decompose → COLLAPSED, recipe/executor/verifier → ACTIVE. All 5 dispositions match expected. collapse_assessment written correctly to recipe.json and receipt. No disposition error.

Medium complexity session with the same module set as case-01. Medium complexity suppresses all collapsing: specify and decompose are collapse_eligible=true but disposition=ACTIVE because complexity != Low. All 5 entries ACTIVE. Confirms Low vs. Medium branching is correctly distinguished. No disposition error. This case provides the signal that Instinct was requesting: a Medium-complexity session with a different collapse_assessment than Low (all ACTIVE vs. two COLLAPSED).
